email_subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoZanix patient with occasional dizziness
email_body:
[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a treating physician at Demo Regional Hospital (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

One of our patients received their second dose of DemoZanix (dose: 1 tablet twice daily) via subcutaneous injection.
Treatment started on 2026-04-14.
Approximately 3 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed occasional dizziness.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
D. Larsen (fictional reporter)
Demo Regional Hospital
Contact: demo.reporter759@fictionalclinic-demo.example (synthetic contact info)
